description: Add WYSIWYG HTML editing to your WinForms application, with Word paste, spell checking and HTML source editing. Supports .NET 10 and .NET Framework 4.5+.
releaseNotes: ClickOnce publishing works with the editor's automatic application manifest: the package now gives ClickOnce a compatible manifest, so a publish no longer stops with MSB3113 for Microsoft.Windows.Common-Controls. The DPI and long-path settings carry over, and ordinary builds and folder publishes are unchanged. No public API changes.
title: SpiceLogic .NET WinForms HTML Editor Control
